translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content.text: Gct, myaszlzq enjrl kxnzetung.
X aclve-zvzq nigr doa neng Josip,
Mz nzapu-krgr sip nemqng.
Lalztqm bagr, nigr doa neng Israel.
X aelwa-ngrm zmatq ngrm bagr,
Nigr nqvi lr Efrem, Benjamin, x Manase.
Vzm mz nzxplr-krm mzli ka
X arlapxbz nigr mz mq enqmi rgrng.
Gct, mz nzaodu-zvz-krm nigr, arlapx nigr,
X ka-mop bagr nzxplr-krgr kc pnz.
Yawe Gct kc tqrninr, bzkq drtwrm ngya-zvzm bagr,
A' ayzlum nzkrka'-krgr.
Tekqtrpebzme dakxnzng nagr mz nzavz-krbzme drtwrgr.
X mz lue amnqtr-zvzpeq nigr mz drlemzkr.
Rlrtx-ngrpwzme mz lr mrkzbleng kcng tzmnc-ngalelr nigr nzyrpalelvz-krdr nigr
X nzotalvz-krdr drtc' nyzgr kx neke nartwz.
Gct kc tqrninr, mz nzaodu-zvz-krm nigr, arlapx nigr,
X ka-mop bagr nzxplr-krgr kc pnz.
Apusr-ngrn nigr nqvi lr grep ngr nrlanc nyzm.
Murde mz nzvzmipx-krme nigr Ijipt,
Apule kx bolvztipeq leplz kxnzmnc-mrbrng mrkc Kenan,
Murde nqvi lr grep nyzm natu-amqngi mz drtc' lc.
X bz ngr nrlanc kc tqoliqtime bagr yzutr mz drtc' ngr Lebanon,
Vz krlzbzle Lue Yufretis.
X vzki-kzple mz newz kxnzetung,
Vz x krlzbzle Prla Meditrenia.
A' mzli ka opxm kx awxlikiq nabxbz ngr nrlanc nyzgr,
Mz nzrlr-krbzme mz enqmi rgrng nzrtwz-abeane-krdr dalr nrlanc.
Lr mrkzbleng nzapulr poi kzpeto kcng tzayabetilr nrlanc,
Mz nzapusr-krdr nigr dakxnzng nadr.
Gct kc tqrninr, obqom bagr Heven.
X okatr-mop nigr mz nzapu-krgr nqvi lr grep nyzm,
Kc tqpetiq
Murde naxplrkr mz nzmnc-krgr mz drtc'.
Ngaprbz ncpa'bu ngrgr kx nao-zlilzkr,
Mz nztu-zvz-krme mz nibrgr, nigr leplz nemqng.
Murde enqmi rgrng nzapusr-ngrdr nigr nounc kc tzlakitxo x nzangc mz nyr.
Delc naodati-ngrbzme nidr mz zngya ngr drtwrm.
Zbz trnaesablqtikru nim,
A' naglqlz-zvzpekr nim mz nzalu-krm nigr.
Yawe Gct kc tqrninr, mz nzaodu-zvz-krm nigr, arlapx nigr,
X ka-mop bagr nzxplr-krgr kc pnz.
